autograder_rules: Tests must verify non-interactive headless flags (--headless, --json).
No network dependencies or live API quota usage during test runs.

atomic_track.title: Antigravity CLI Binary Path & Version Probe
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Starter script fails to locate mock-bin/agy because PATH is unset, and invokes interactive mode instead of --headless.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies agy binary resolves to mock-bin/agy without network lookup
Asserts execution includes --headless and --json flags
Checks exit status is 0 and output parses valid JSON via jq

atomic_track.title: Headless Output Deserialization with jq
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Starter pipeline parses raw stdout without handling multiline JSON streaming from agy run --headless.
test_assertion_criteria: Ensures pipeline feeds agy output to jq with --exit-status
Asserts key metadata.status equals COMPLETED
Fails if any unescaped ANSI codes pollute JSON output

atomic_track.title: Offline Environment Guard & API Key Stubbing
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Starter script attempts to check live remote endpoint if GEMINI_API_KEY is not defined instead of enforcing AGY_OFFLINE_MODE=1.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies execution fails fast when network access is attempted
Asserts AGY_OFFLINE_MODE=1 environment variable is passed to mock-bin/agy
Checks that no outbound socket calls are made

atomic_track.title: Antigravity CLI Config Initialization
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Configuration loader parses agy.config.json using relative paths that break when invoked outside the root directory.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts config loader locates .devcontainer and root configs dynamically
Verifies headless default boolean is set to True
Validates configuration schema against mock-bin/agy requirements

atomic_track.title: Non-Interactive Session Spawning
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Starter bats test hangs indefinitely because agy session start omits --headless and awaits stdin.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies --headless flag is passed to agy session start
Confirms mock session token is captured from stdout JSON
Validates exit code 0 within timeout limit

atomic_track.title: Mock Binary Fixture Injection
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Python subprocess wrapper calls global agy executable instead of injected mock-bin/agy fixture in isolated tests.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies PATH manipulation prepends mock-bin directory
Asserts subprocess command array contains --json flag
Asserts mock response payload conforms to expected schema

atomic_track.title: BATS Test Suite Assertion for CLI Exit Codes
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: test.bats checks stdout regex instead of explicit exit code semantics for missing command arguments.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies bats test asserts status equals 2 on invalid arguments
Asserts error JSON payload contains code INVALID_ARGUMENT
Ensures stderr contains structured error output

atomic_track.title: Gemini Spark Prompt Assembly & Escaping
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Prompt template builder fails to escape double quotes and multiline variables when constructing JSON CLI payloads.
test_assertion_criteria: Validates generated JSON payload passes json.loads() without syntax error
Asserts prompt string contains required Spark role tags
Ensures --payload parameter is passed correctly to agy run

atomic_track.title: Headless Agent Dispatcher Script
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Dispatcher script uses interactive read prompts to select task category rather than parsing CLI arguments.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts script processes --task and --category flags non-interactively
Verifies invocation of agy agent dispatch --headless
Checks JSON result envelope contains task_id and status

atomic_track.title: Subprocess Error Capture & Logging
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Subprocess caller swallows stderr on non-zero exit codes, obscuring mock-bin diagnostic messages.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies subprocess.CalledProcessError captures stderr output
Asserts error logger emits structured JSON log entry
Verifies mock-bin/agy failure modes are propagated faithfully

atomic_track.title: Deterministic Response Fixture Parser
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Response parser assumes single-chunk output and crashes on chunked JSON lines from agy stream --headless.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts streaming JSON parser handles newline-delimited JSON chunks
Verifies accumulator reconstructs full Gemini Spark response
Validates zero live API requests are made during parsing

atomic_track.title: JSON Schema Validation for Spark Artifacts
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Validator script does not validate generated artifact metadata against monorepo schema before saving.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts jsonschema.validate confirms required schema fields
Checks validation failure raises descriptive ValidationError without network fetch
Verifies compliance with track-atomic output contracts

atomic_track.title: Batch Job Dispatcher with Bats Runner
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Batch runner does not stop on first failure and loses individual exit codes in loop iteration.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies test.bats checks each batch iteration independently
Asserts agy batch --headless --json execution
Confirms batch summary report is generated in valid JSON format

atomic_track.title: Environment Isolation & Temporary Sandbox
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Starter script pollutes monorepo root by creating temporary session files directly in current working directory.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts creation and cleanup of mktemp isolated directory
Verifies agy --workdir points strictly to temporary sandbox
Checks workspace cleanup on EXIT trap

atomic_track.title: Gemini Spark Tool Call Serialization
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Tool call serializer outputs snake_case keys instead of camelCase expected by Antigravity 2.0 runtime schema.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts serialized function call parameters adhere to camelCase spec
Checks mock-bin/agy accepts serialized tool payload without schema rejection
Verifies json round-trip invariance

atomic_track.title: Headless Status Polling Loop
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Polling loop runs an unbounded while loop without sleep or timeout limit, causing CI test runner timeout.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies loop implements fixed maximum retry count and interval
Asserts agy status --headless --json is polled non-interactively
Confirms loop exits with status 0 upon COMPLETED

atomic_track.title: Mock CLI Response Interceptor
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Interceptor fails to match mock command regex patterns due to unstripped trailing whitespace.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts regex matcher accurately matches agy CLI subcommands
Verifies interceptor returns designated mock-bin fixture without network
Checks returned exit code mirrors mocked response definition

atomic_track.title: Antigravity Workspace Manifest Generation
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Manifest generator produces invalid JSON due to unhandled datetime objects and missing serializable encoder.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts manifest generation produces strictly valid JSON
Verifies metadata contains monorepo version and timestamp
Checks manifest load test passes with json.loads

atomic_track.title: BATS Mock Verification for Network Egress Block
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: test.bats does not assert offline isolation or mock environment block, allowing potential test leakage.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts test environment executes under mocked network boundary
Verifies any attempted network connection produces mocked error code
Checks bats assertion fails if non-mock binary is referenced

atomic_track.title: Antigravity CLI Argument Sanitizer
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Sanitizer fails to quote user input containing shell metacharacters prior to passing to subprocess.Popen.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies shell injection characters are safely escaped or parameterized
Asserts arguments are passed as list rather than shell=True string
Ensures agy invocation executes safely under test assertions

atomic_track.title: Gemini Spark Multi-Turn Conversation State Reducer
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: State reducer drops role history when appending tool result messages to the conversation buffer.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts conversation turns maintain alternating user/model roles
Verifies tool response messages are formatted correctly for Spark
Asserts serialization to --headless session payload succeeds

atomic_track.title: Headless Failure Telemetry Formatter
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Telemetry script sends logs to stdout as raw text, breaking downstream jq consumers in CI.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts error telemetry is emitted strictly as newline-delimited JSON
Verifies jq .severity and .message can parse every log line
Checks bats test fails if plain text lines are detected

atomic_track.title: Mock CLI Fixture Override Mechanism
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Starter script hardcodes fixture path instead of respecting AGY_FIXTURE_PATH environment override.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts AGY_FIXTURE_PATH override takes precedence over defaults
Verifies mock-bin/agy serves designated JSON fixture
Checks test.bats verifies dynamic fixture switching

atomic_track.title: Antigravity 2.0 Task Manifest Validator
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Task manifest validator permits missing autograder block in day specifications.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts validator checks presence of starter, solution, and test.bats
Verifies validation errors report missing keys clearly
Confirms test asserts pass on valid atomic track folder structures

atomic_track.title: BATS Execution Timeout & Deadlock Guard
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: BATS test runner lacks command timeout wrapper, causing tests to hang indefinitely if agy deadlocks.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts test.bats invokes commands via timeout 10s wrapper
Verifies return code 124 triggers actionable timeout failure message
Checks test suite finishes within offline test runner quota

atomic_track.title: Python Subprocess Signal Handling & Graceful Termination
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: CLI wrapper leaves orphaned mock-bin processes running in background upon SIGTERM.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies signal handlers catch SIGINT and SIGTERM cleanly
Asserts child process terminate and kill routines execute
Checks test verifies no dangling agy PID in process table

atomic_track.title: Spark Capability Manifest Generator
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Script generates malformed tool declarations missing parameter type specifications required by Gemini Spark.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts tool declaration parameters contain required type and description fields
Verifies JSON schema compliance with Antigravity 2.0 tool interface
Asserts offline validation against mock-bin/agy

atomic_track.title: Structured Diff Assessor for Starter vs Solution
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Diff checker returns 0 even when starter and solution files are completely identical.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts script returns non-zero exit code if starter equals solution
Verifies unified diff summary is formatted as JSON
Checks test.bats fails on zero-diff challenge folders

atomic_track.title: Offline Dependency Integrity Verifier
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Integrity checker queries remote repository rather than checking local wheels/cache in .devcontainer.
test_assertion_criteria: Verifies check operates strictly against local environment packages
Asserts verification succeeds without internet connectivity
Checks error is raised if bats-core or jq is missing from PATH

atomic_track.title: Full Atomic Track CI Pre-Flight Runner
atomic_track.starter_bug_description: Pre-flight script fails to aggregate BATS test results across all 30 days and exits prematurely on first non-fatal warning.
test_assertion_criteria: Asserts runner executes test.bats across all track-atomic subdirectories
Verifies final summary report conforms to non-interactive JSON schema
Asserts exit code 0 only when all 30 daily suites pass

sprint_track.title: Headless CLI Foundation & Mock Runtime Harness
sprint_track.capstone_goal: Build a resilient, headless execution harness wrapping Antigravity CLI (mock-bin/agy) with deterministic JSON output, error interceptors, and complete offline test coverage.
pytest_criteria: test_cli_headless_invocation: Verifies agy is invoked with --headless and --json flags and returns exit code 0
test_offline_boundary_enforcement: Verifies socket.socket connections are intercepted and blocked during execution
test_mock_binary_fallback: Validates mock-bin/agy fixture substitution under AGY_OFFLINE_MODE=1
test_json_schema_validation: Asserts harness stdout adheres to Antigravity CLI 2.0 output schema

sprint_track.title: Gemini Spark Autonomous Agent & Tool Dispatcher
sprint_track.capstone_goal: Implement a multi-step autonomous agent dispatcher using Gemini Spark prompts, stateful multi-turn history tracking, and headless function calling over local workspace files.
pytest_criteria: test_agent_dispatch_headless: Verifies agent orchestrates tasks without prompt pauses using --headless
test_tool_call_routing: Confirms function calls are routed to local workspace tools without external API requests
test_multi_turn_state_preservation: Asserts history buffer maintains context integrity across iterative tool invocations
test_agent_timeout_and_recovery: Validates agent recovers gracefully from mock CLI execution timeouts

sprint_track.title: Antigravity 2.0 Multi-Agent Pipeline & Artifact Engine
sprint_track.capstone_goal: Develop an agentic pipeline engine that coordinates multiple specialized Spark subagents to generate, critique, and validate structured repository code artifacts headlessly.
pytest_criteria: test_pipeline_multi_agent_flow: Asserts generator and critic subagents communicate through structured JSON envelopes
test_artifact_deterministic_output: Confirms generated code artifacts match expected golden hashes under mock seeds
test_headless_critic_evaluation: Verifies critic evaluation runs non-interactively and flags intentional anomalies
test_patch_application_safety: Validates diff_patcher rejects malformed patches without corrupting workspace files

sprint_track.title: Enterprise Autograder & Offline CI/CD Verification Suite
sprint_track.capstone_goal: Construct an end-to-end autograding system capable of testing and validating all 30 atomic daily challenges and 3 preceding sprint capstones in an offline, air-gapped CI container.
pytest_criteria: test_autograder_batch_evaluation: Verifies autograder runs all 30 atomic test.bats and parses structured results
test_zero_network_leakage: Confirms pytest suite executes strictly offline with all egress blocked
test_non_interactive_report_generation: Validates grade_reporter outputs valid machine-readable JSON without manual interaction
test_sandbox_containment: Asserts tested code execution cannot modify parent directories outside designated sandbox
